info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables the modification of external agency details based on a specified identifier. It supports updating specific attributes of an agency that is part of the banking domain. Ideal for service providers needing to keep agency data current, this operation allows for selective changes, ensuring that the most relevant information is maintained without affecting other data elements. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial services that require dynamic management of partner agency information.

patch.description: This operation allows the client to update the details of a specific product service agency identified by its unique ID. It will modify the existing product service data based on the provided information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product information for the specified external agency service. You must provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the product service entry.

200.description: Request processed successfully, returning updated resource.
